name: roflenox-embedder
description: The embedder executor for ROFLENOX: answers search-by-meaning intents in its own book. A separate package: it may take dependencies (a model) that the core never does.

scripts.fetch-model: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings -e "const { learned } = await import('./embed.ts'); await learned(process.env.ROFLENOX_EMBED_MODEL); console.log('model ready')"
